text:
Sasha: quick question for the rerank contract — how should the service behave when an item has no `score` (null/missing)? do we treat as lowest, drop it, or preserve input order?

Maya: we should preserve determinism. prefer treating missing/null as -Infinity so it sorts last, but keep stable sort using request-provided order as tie-breaker.

Vikram: narrowing: there are two related things — (1) sort order when score missing, (2) tie-breaking when scores equal. spec currently says clients rely on stable order but doesn't mandate extra fields. we should add an explicit `tie_breaker` output to avoid accidental nondeterminism.

Joe: +1 on explicit tie field. implementation note: compute `tie_hash = sha1(request_id + item_id)` on server and include numeric `tie_breaker` in response. Use it only for deterministic ordering when scores equal (or scores both missing).

Lena: small compatibility concern — legacy clients might ignore new `tie_breaker`. can we also add a `rank` integer (1..N) so older clients still get a deterministic position without needing parsing?

Vikram: yes add `rank`. semantics: we guarantee `rank` reflects final output order after scoring & tie-break. `score` may be null in the item object, but `rank` is always present for each returned candidate.

Sasha: sounds good. quick sketch of response shape for the spec PR — please sanity-check: 
```json
{
  "request_id": "uuid-abc123",
  "items": [
    {"id": "doc-1", "score": 0.942, "tie_breaker": 1234567890, "rank": 1},
    {"id": "doc-2", "score": null,  "tie_breaker": 9876543210, "rank": 3},
    {"id": "doc-3", "score": 0.942, "tie_breaker": 2222222222, "rank": 2}
  ]
}
```

Maya: one nuance — when `score` is null we still want clients to know it was evaluated but missing. keep `score: null` not `-inf` in output JSON. Sorting behavior is implementation detail in server: treat null as less-than any numeric during sort. document this in contract.

Joe: agree. also add small note that clients should not rely on tie_breaker values being stable across model version changes — only use `rank` if they need a stable position snapshot.

Sasha: good call. action items: (1) Maya to update spec PR to add `tie_breaker` (number), `rank` (int), and explicit rule: null `score` sorts last. (2) Vikram to add deterministic tie_hash pseudo-code in runtime docs. (3) Lena to validate legacy client behavior in canary.

Maya: I'll open the PR today and include the snippet + a one-paragraph backward-compatibility note.

deploy-bot: deployment queued for canary group `rerank-api` at 2024-11-20T18:33:00Z :rocket:

Lena: pinging @eng-oncall for canary verification once PR merges.

Sasha: thanks all — leaving this thread open for a few hours for any objections. :thumbsup:

Vikram: no objections from me. one extra test: include a randomized ordering unit test that asserts deterministic ranks for same seed across jobs.

Joe: added to my TODO list for the test harness.

Sasha: great — resolving after PR lands.
